style: Avant-garde garage-rock and music-hall brass band collision. Harmony uses quartal suspended chord fields with microtonal rubbing against parallel triad blocks. Melody combines fast chromatic cabaret patter with wide operatic melisma. Rhythm features irregular duple accents, 7/8 asymmetric stomps, and punk silences. Timbre pairs upright slap bass, distorted sax, cheap pump organ, and spring reverb. Performance attitude is hyper-articulate nervous energy with deadpan tabloid urgency. Production features 1960s mono tape saturation with frequency gating and room collapse. Operators: hold the brass stabs fixed while the piano microtones migrate; compress the drum pocket while stretching the vocal melisma; make the saxophone hocket behave like a telegraph machine; preserve the upright bass anchor while destabilizing the meter; force 7/8 stomps and 4/4 swing to occupy the same downbeat.
lyrics:
[TONE: TRASHY SPECTACLE] [FORMAT: TABLOID NEWS SPECIAL] [WORLD: INTERDIMENSIONAL TRUCK STOP] [HEADSPACE: BEWILDERMENT] [ALTERED STATE: LSD SENSORY CROSSWIRE] [ENERGY: HYPER-DRIVE OVERLOAD] [SECTION 1: BREAKING NEWS TEASER]
[Urgent anchor desk desk chatter] [Sound of glass shattering into neon orange paint] 
Tonight! At eleven! The interstate pump five has leaked into a temporal sideways dimension, creating massive systemic chaos across all local municipal frequencies!
[Announcer shouts over distorted trumpet smear] 
What the fuck is going on at the grease trap behind the mutant diner where reality itself is unraveling at the seams?
[Field reporter voice, shaky room capture] 
I am standing right now in three gallons of spilled yesterday! The tarmac is tasting intensely like copper wire and aggressive polka music while cars float away like helium balloons!

[SECTION 2: WITNESS INTERVIEW AND SENSORY DISTORTION]
[Fast cabaret patter, upright bass slap, tack piano clusters]
Trucker Jim says his windshield turned into an ancient map of Liverpool and part of ancient Rome!
He tried to wipe the morning frost off, but his wiper blades started singing loud soprano opera!
[Soprano melisma leaps up, crashing into distorted sax hocket]
"I can't see the highway anymore! My steering wheel smells completely like burnt toast and contentious parliamentary debates!"
Everything is melting sideways into blinding green geometry and pulsing neon vectors!
[Punk silences, hard drum kick, tape flutter]
What the fuck is going on with the gas pump meters spinning wildly backwards straight into the Cretaceous period with actual dinosaurs!

[SECTION 3: EXPERT SPECULATION AND SUBSTRATE MIGRATION]
[Music hall brass band stabs, microtonal rubbing, deadpan spoken narration]
Dr. Zox from Sector Nine states officially that the planetary gear ratio has slipped its moorings entirely.
Instead of moving forward normally through time, we are currently sliding laterally across our absolute worst bad decisions!
[Call-and-response doo-wop backing vocals, highly compressed]
[Backing vocals]: Bad decisions! Very greasy! Extremely questionable life choices!
[Lead vocal, operatic recitative over fuzz guitar]
Every single time you drop a quarter in the air compressor, a small lizard is born in someone else's left nostril across three separate galaxies!
Explain that bizarre phenomenon to the local zoning board! Explain that to the bewildered highway patrol officers!
[Sound of spring reverb collapsing, tape speed drop]

[SECTION 4: DRAMATIC REENACTMENT]
[Additive 7/8 asymmetric meter, manic stomping, accordion wheeze]
Let's recreate the absolute panic at the convenience store counter right now!
Customer wants a black coffee! Counter clerk calmly hands him a live badger made entirely of crackling radio static!
[Screaming vocal hocket, rapid consonant percussion]
B-B-B-Badger static! Coffee beans suddenly turned into small copper coins that taste exclusively like Tuesday afternoons!
[Altered state shift: time becomes spatial distance]
Every single second you stand near the malfunctioning slush machine adds four miles to your actual childhood bedroom!
I am currently walking backward through my own kitchen while eating a lukewarm hot dog in the middle of a raging Nebraska blizzard!

[SECTION 5: NEW EVIDENCE AND THRESHOLD COLLAPSE]
[Phase banshee threshold crossing, screeching sax, distorted organ swell]
Wait! Look at the surveillance monitors! The parking lot white lines are completely unzipping themselves!
They're crawling up the greasy diner walls like angry neon yellow caterpillars looking for blood!
[Patter singing at near-spoken speed, frantic energy]
Who authorized this catastrophic topological error? Who signed the official permit for consensus reality to fold directly in half?
[Stacked close harmony, barbershop tension]
We didn't pay any extra money for the deluxe package! We only wanted regular unleaded and a small bag of stale potato chips!
[Screamed ensemble hook]
What the fuck is going on! What the fuck is going on with the entire universe today!

[SECTION 6: CLIFFHANGER AND STATION IDENTIFICATION]
[Abrupt drop to dry mono room capture, single ticking clock, telephone static]
Tune in tomorrow when the endless highway eats the entire horizon and your trusted steering wheel permanently turns into your grandmother's unsolicited opinion about your life.
[Final trashy brass fanfare, spring reverb burst, sudden gate cut]
caption: An avant-garde garage-rock and music-hall brass spectacular driven by interdimensional tabloid hysteria and LSD sensory crosswiring. The track features 7/8 asymmetric meters, quartal microtonal rubbing, and frantic cabaret patter to map a total breakdown of reality at a cosmic truck stop.
